items.title: Fred Lipsius interviewed by Monk Rowe. Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018
items.q: I used to play it with a friend of mine named Hugh Young and me, we used to play clarinet duets.

ctx.x: And I was saying he was a master compiler I think. I loved watching his interview with Paul Desmond. There’s something that really touched my heart, for whatever he was with the drugs and everything. And you know Desmond is saying, “You’ve gone way beyond all of us.” And he said, “Well I practice ten hours a day.” But he didn’t practice ten hours a day for twenty years. It was only a few years. He died at 35 or whatever. But he said, and he said it very graciously with a little smile on his face if you look at…
